name: h1
author: Jake Handy
tagline: Fourteen animated instruments for the FM-1
description: Fourteen instruments, each a full-screen animated picture you play. PRESETS changes the instrument, ALGORITHM changes its character, and the four knobs always shape the sound and the picture together. With a loop recorder, a step sequencer, an arpeggiator and a metronome.
credits: h1 is built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp, which come from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments.
